title.narrative: Danish Contribution to Transformational Energy Access for Sierra Leone Project

description.narrative: Increase generation and access to sustainable, reliable and affordable energy for productive use by households and communities

The Danish Contribution to Transforming Energy Access in Sierra Leone Project focuses on provision of green energy through mini-grids. It uses a delegated partnership with the EU Delegation in Sierra Leone to support the generation and distribution infrastructure for sustainable, reliable and affordable energy and improve access to electricity. The project has a budget of DKK20 million, out of which an administrative fee of the equivalent of DKK250,000 administrative fee will be paid to the EUD.
The project is designed based on the EU’s Multiannual Indicative Programme (MIP) 2021 – 2027, with specific focus on the Action Document for Transformational Energy Access for Sierra Leone and has a time frame of 24 months up December 2026. The project’s specific objective is to contribute to increased generation and access to modern, sustainable, affordable and reliable energy for jobs and growth which ensures energy access for productive use for households and communities.
